project: Hawadeet World - EP02 Candy City (test scene)
story: نور ولُمعة والفانوس بيطيروا لمدينة كل حاجة فيها معمولة من الحلويات، عشان يدوّروا على أول حتة من بلّورة الأحلام. القيمة: الاعتدال والمشاركة.
script: مشهد تجريبي: نور ولُمعة والفانوس بينزلوا في مدخل مدينة الحلويات، ونور مبهورة. (من غير كلام)
style: High-end 3D animated family movie style (Pixar-like), soft cinematic lighting, warm pastel candy colors under a magical night sky, cozy bedtime mood, gentle slow camera moves, 16:9, no text, no letters.

characters.name: Nour
characters.description: 6-year-old Egyptian girl, warm light-brown skin, big round dark-brown eyes, rosy cheeks, two long dark-brown braids with small yellow ribbons, light-blue button pajamas with small white stars, barefoot. Wears a small silver necklace with eight empty star-shaped slots.

characters.name: Lumaa
characters.description: Tiny soft glowing pale-yellow five-pointed star with big shiny eyes, rosy cheeks and small arms. Floats and flies, leaves golden sparkles.

characters.name: The Lantern
characters.description: Ornate golden Egyptian Ramadan lantern (fanoos) with red, blue and green stained-glass panes, warm amber glow, a kind cute face on the front glass, a silver ring on top. Floats in the air. NOT an oil lamp.

characters.name: Baskota
characters.description: Small cheerful gingerbread boy the size of Nour's knee, golden-brown cookie body with white icing smile and icing buttons, two candy-button eyes, a tiny white chef hat. Playful, bouncy, friendly.

locations.name: Candy City
locations.description: A magical city made of sweets at night: houses built from biscuits with colorful sugar-glass windows, a slow river of melted chocolate with a wafer bridge, cotton-candy trees in pink and blue, giant lollipop street lamps glowing softly, sprinkles on the cobblestone road, a tall cake mountain topped with a giant cherry in the distance, starry navy sky with a crescent moon.

scenes.title: Arrival in Candy City
scenes.shot: WIDE SHOT, slow push-in. Nour floats down holding the lantern's silver ring, Lumaa flying beside her, and they land gently on the sprinkle-covered street at the entrance of Candy City. Nour looks around with wide amazed eyes and an open smile; Lumaa twirls happily; the lantern glows warmer.
scenes.motion: Gentle, slow, calm bedtime-story motion. Cotton-candy trees sway softly, the chocolate river flows slowly, lollipop lamps twinkle.
scenes.audio: No dialogue, no lip movement, no music. Soft magical chime and tiny bells only.
